title: Ebenezer and Aphek
text: Now the Israelites went out to meet the Philistines in battle and camped at Ebenezer, while the Philistines camped at Aphek.

title: About Four Thousand Men
text: … who struck down about four thousand men on the battlefield.

title: Let Us Bring the Ark
text: Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Shiloh, so that it may go with us to save us from the hand of our enemies.

title: Enthroned between the Cherubim
text: … the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Hosts, who sits enthroned between the cherubim.

title: The Ground Shook
text: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD entered the camp, all the Israelites raised such a great shout that the ground shook.

title: The Gods Have Entered Their Camp
text: The gods have entered their camp! | Woe to us, for nothing like this has happened before.

title: Mighty Gods
text: Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods?

title: Be Men and Fight
text: Take courage and be men, O Philistines!

title: The Ark Was Captured
text: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

title: Hophni and Phinehas
text: … and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

title: Ichabod
text: And she named the boy Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel …

title: To Ashdod
text: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod …

title: Beside His Statue
text: … carried it into the temple of Dagon, and set it beside his statue.

title: Dagon Fallen on His Face
text: … there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD.

title: Returned to His Place
text: So they took Dagon and returned him to his place.

title: His Head and Hands Broken Off
text: … with his head and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold. Only the torso remained.

title: Do Not Step on the Threshold
text: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.

title: The Hand of the LORD Was Heavy
text: Now the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity …

title: Afflicted with Tumors
text: … ravaging them and afflicting them with tumors.

title: Moved to Gath
text: The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon.

title: To Kill Us
text: They have brought us the ark of the God of Israel in order to kill us and our people!

title: Send Away the Ark
text: Send away the ark of the God of Israel. It must return to its place …

title: Seven Months
text: When the ark of the LORD had been in the land of the Philistines seven months …

title: A Guilt Offering
text: … do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering.

title: You Will Understand
text: Then you will be healed, and you will understand why His hand has not been lifted from you.

title: One New Cart
text: Now, therefore, prepare one new cart with two milk cows that have never been yoked.

title: Cows That Had Never Been Yoked
text: … two milk cows that have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.

title: Toward Beth-shemesh
text: If it goes up the road to its homeland, toward Beth-shemesh, it is the LORD who has brought on us this great disaster.

title: Gold Rats and Images of Tumors
text: … along with the chest containing the gold rats and the images of the tumors.

title: Penned Up Their Calves
text: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.

title: Straight Up the Road
text: And the cows headed straight up the road toward Beth-shemesh, staying on that one highway and lowing as they went, never straying to the right or to the left.

title: The Rulers Followed
text: The rulers of the Philistines followed behind them to the border of Beth-shemesh.

title: Overjoyed at the Sight
text: … and when they looked up and saw the ark, they were overjoyed at the sight.

title: The Field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh
text: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock.

title: A Large Rock
text: … and stopped there near a large rock.

title: A Burnt Offering
text: The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

title: The Levites Took Down the Ark
text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the chest containing the gold objects, and they placed them on the large rock.

title: Who Can Stand?
text: Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God?

title: Kiriath-jearim
text: So they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath-jearim …

title: Twenty Years
text: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim.

title: Put Away the Foreign Gods
text: If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you …

title: Serve Him Only
text: … prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only.

title: They Put Away the Baals
text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.

title: Thus Far the LORD Has Helped Us
text: He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”

title: Eli's Two Sons
text: And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

title: Four Thousand Men
text: … who struck down about four thousand men on the battlefield.

title: The Glory Has Departed
text: The glory has departed from Israel …

title: Return It with a Guilt Offering
text: … do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering.

title: The Threshold
text: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.

title: They Were Overjoyed
text: … they were overjoyed at the sight.

title: In the Presence of the LORD
text: Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God?
